svg.title: Conical frustum: lateral surface area
svg.desc: A conical frustum and a matching axial half-section. The radii are r and R. The frustum generator has length s, and its extension to the apex has length x. The blue midpoint circle has radius (R+r)/2. Equal marks identify the generator midpoint. By similar triangles, r/x = R/(x+s), hence (R-r)x = rs, so x = rs/(R-r). The lateral area is pi (R+r) s; both circular caps are excluded.
svg.title: Conical frustum: lateral surface area
